jobs.title: Event Guest Services Associate - Flexible Hours, Weekly Pay
jobs.description:
Allied Universal® Event Services is hiring Event Staff to support large events, venues, and gatherings. You will welcome guests, usher them to seats, and provide excellent customer service at sports arenas, concerts, and festivals.

The role offers flexible part-time and full-time schedules, with starting pay at $17 per hour. A security license is required, and duties include ticket collection, guest assistance, and crowd management to ensure safety and a positive guest experience.

jobs.description:
Texas Children's Hospital in Houston is seeking a full-time night shift NCSO Security Officer to maintain a safe environment for patients, visitors and staff.

You will staff posts, monitor access, document logs, and respond to emergencies, working as a visible deterrent and coordinating with security leadership.

Candidates should have a High School diploma, BLS, NCSO and Texas Driver's License, with a year of security or related experience.
